annotations.title: Are we ahead of or behind our peers on this metric?

description: Use when the user names a public company and asks how its growth, margin, R&D or marketing spend compares with competitors. Returns the company's revenue growth, gross margin, or R&D or sales-and-marketing as a share of revenue for its latest fiscal year, each peer's, the peer median, the gap and the rank, from SEC EDGAR XBRL as filed; every excluded peer is named with the reason. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: latest fiscal year only; compare: peers (the comparison set); segment: metric (growth, margin, R&D, S&M, ad intensity). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For where the revenue comes from, use run_revenue_mix. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/peer-benchmark.json

metric.description: What to compare, from each company's latest 10-K: revenue_growth (revenue growth), gross_margin (gross margin), rd_intensity (R&D as a share of revenue), sm_intensity (sales and marketing as a share of revenue), ad_intensity (advertising as a share of revenue), operating_margin (operating margin).

peers.description: 2-6 peer tickers from the same list, comma-separated, e.g. "CAG,CPB,KHC".
